lines.ja: さゆりさんと瞬さんとお寿司を食べに来ました！
lines.en: I came to eat sushi with Sayuri and Shun!
lines.speaker: Miku

lines.en: Yay!
lines.speaker: All

lines.ja: お寿司の前の前菜です！
lines.en: These are the appetizers before the sushi!
lines.speaker: Miku

lines.en: It looks so delicious!
lines.speaker: Shun

lines.en: The quality is on a different level.
lines.speaker: Sayuri

lines.en: Yeah, it's in a league of its own.
lines.speaker: Sayuri

lines.ja: え、なんでスシローと違うの？何が違うの？
lines.en: Wait, why is it different from Sushiro? What's different?
lines.speaker: Shun

lines.ja: まず仕入れてるところが全然違うでしょう。
lines.en: First of all, where they source it from is completely different.
lines.speaker: Miku

lines.en: Ah, it's so good.
lines.speaker: Shun

lines.ja: あの、厚みが違うね、スシローとは。
lines.en: Well, the thickness is different compared to Sushiro.
lines.speaker: Sayuri

lines.en: Totally different.
lines.speaker: Shun

lines.en: Isn't it kind of sweet?
lines.speaker: Miku

lines.en: It is sweet!
lines.speaker: Shun

clips.title: I Want to Do Nothing at All
grammar: 〜てみたい — want to try doing

lines.ja: なんかやってみたいことある？これから。
lines.en: Is there anything you want to try doing going forward?
lines.speaker: Miku

lines.ja: 別に日本語教師じゃなくてもいいよ。何かやりたいことある？
lines.en: It doesn't have to be teaching Japanese. Is there anything you want to do?
lines.speaker: Miku

lines.ja: 逆に何もやりたくない。
lines.en: On the contrary, I don't want to do anything.
lines.speaker: Sayuri

lines.en: Really?! Is that so?
lines.speaker: Shun

lines.en: I've been so busy lately.
lines.speaker: Sayuri

lines.ja: ああ、忙しいのは分かるけど。
lines.en: Ah, I get being busy, but...
lines.speaker: Shun

lines.ja: 昨日、適当に入った喫茶店にあった本なんだけど、
lines.en: Yesterday, in a café I randomly walked into, there was a book...
lines.speaker: Sayuri

lines.ja: 「あやうく一生懸命生きるところだった」みたいな。
lines.en: Something like 'I almost lived life trying too hard.'
lines.speaker: Sayuri

lines.en: Oh wow!
lines.speaker: Shun
